content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Jodhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Jodhpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur (IIT Jodhpur) for filling up various non-faculty positions across different departments and administrative wings.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIT Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 20 vacancies have been announced for various non-faculty positions including Assistant Registrar, Counselor, Medical Officer, Technical Assistants, and administrative roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Jodhpur Non-Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for IIT Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 is 30-10-2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively through online mode by visiting the official website of IIT Jodhpur or via the direct application link provided.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the advertised positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be placed in the pay matrix ranging from Level 3 to Level 10 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) structure depending on the post.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for Assistant Registrar?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Assistant Registrar post must possess a Master’s degree in any discipline with at least 55% marks along with relevant supervisory and institutional experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for SC/ST and women candidates?
faq.answer: No, candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwBD, EWS, Women, Ex-Servicemen, and internal categories are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for Junior Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Technical Assistant post is 27 years, with permissible age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Jodhpur Non-Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically comprises written tests, skill or trade tests, and/or presentations or interviews depending on the requirements of the specific post.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by visiting the Important Links section of this article and clicking on the designated official notification link.
